idea-plugin.name: Nunjucks Support
idea-plugin.description:
Support for Nunjucks templates (.njk, .nunjucks).
  • Syntax highlighting of tags, expressions, filters, tests and comments, with HTML (or any other template data language) highlighted and completed in between
  • Completion of tags (including the right closing tag), filters, tests, variables, macros, loop members, imported macros, block names and template paths
  • Go to declaration for variables, macros, imports, blocks and template paths. For variables that are not declared in the template, finds where they come from: including templates, child and parent templates, front matter, render("template", {...}) calls in JavaScript/TypeScript, addGlobal(), app.locals and Eleventy _data files
  • Navigation to custom filters, globals and shortcodes registered with addFilter(), addGlobal(), addShortcode() and friends
  • Block override gutter icons, find usages and rename, folding, brace matching, {# #} commenting, auto-closing delimiters, quick documentation and live templates

action.description: Show where this template is rendered: render() calls, references in code, and templates that include or extend it
